the decrease in calmodulin binding during capacitation is due to a decrease in the intracellular concentrations of calmodulin, and this decrease is due to the release of this protein from the perinuclear area.

the localization of calmodulins and its binding proteins is a dynamic process, and that this localization is altered during capacitation.
